newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says economy speed limits could rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says economy speed limits could rise.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government could increase the speed limits on economic growth with sustained work.

"The important thing to remember is this, if we can keep that inflation low, if we can start addressing our savings problem in this country, we can increase the speed limits on growth," Costello told reporters.
"I don't say we can increase the speed limits on growth immediately.
"It's going to be sustained work and it's going to take a good budget."
The Reserve Bank earlier eased monetary policy, dropping its overnight cash rate target to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.

The bank said the decision to cut rates was taken by the board in view of the improvement in the outlook for inflation, which had increased the scope for the economy to sustain a faster rate of growth.
